exploratory_focal.label: baseline-focal
exploratory_focal.reason: The first focal ran in the working checkout while edits began after collection; replaced by one definitive focal on the frozen baseline checkout.

phase_rows_note: Null means no report for that phase, as in setup-skipped cases; durations are rounded to 0.01 s.
junit_case_rows_note: The suite count includes passing subtests; JUnit exposes one row per main testcase. Phase rows use the maximum report per case/phase to avoid counting nested subtest duration twice.

environment.measurement_note: Measured pytest profiles serialized. Lightweight administrative/static reads overlapped the baseline; no concurrent functional test suite. Full baseline in an unmodified detached worktree; same locked virtual environment, public data, approval pins and pytest options.
environment.measurement_input_note: Tracked public clone only; no warehouse, Silver, private Gold cubes, approval ledger or node_modules copied from the prepared main checkout.

caveats: One serialized pair per profile on this cloud instance; no statistical speed guarantee or extrapolation to GitHub runners.

pytest phase durations are rounded to 0.01 s in --durations output; maximum report per case/phase avoids double-counting nested subtest reports. JUnit stores inclusive case totals and suite time. Use measured process wall time for the paired comparison.
The public profile excludes local_data and browser; it does not establish private-data or publication acceptance.
The financial-publication-base verifies the unchanged published site with its released verifier; it does not authorize candidate runtime.

caveats: One matched pair on the same four-CPU GitHub runner, hostname verified. No statistical or future timing guarantee. This is the complete public pytest profile, not the entire job or private/browser profile.

CPU totals include child-family CPU plus sampler CPU. Sampled aggregate RSS sums simultaneous process RSS every nominal0.2s and may count shared pages more than once or miss short peaks; kernel largest-child RSS is separate.
Two workers duplicate some imports/session preparation; this trades extra CPU/memory for lower wall time on already allocated cores. No safety verdict or approval is reused.

Each worker records full fresh selected/deselected inventory. xdist may omit the deselected count from terminal output; the106 exclusions are validated from inventories. Subtest identities/outcomes use raw worker records, not a second repr of reconstructed controller context.

Temporary collection/measurement instruments are retained in the fixed benchmark commit. Final CI removes them and the serial baseline; application/test inputs and dependency pins retain their measured behavior, with final-head CI/review required.
